### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **contemporary educational psychology contribution** — current theoretical advances in learning, motivation, instruction, or assessment.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure educational research without psychology theory redirected to AERA journals.

### AI-Research Notes (WO2 supplement, 2026-07-13)

> Added by `scripts/spine/patch_existing_entries.py` as a **supplementary, independent research pass** — it does NOT overwrite or supersede the Tier assessment above. Treat conflicts as a signal to re-verify, not as an automatic correction. Overall WO2 `signal_quality` for this pass: **2/5**.

**WO2 AI policy finding:** publisher-level (Elsevier) policy, not journal-specific: authors may use generative AI tools in a limited, supportive way during manuscript preparation but must disclose use (tool name, purpose, extent of oversight) in a mandatory 'Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies' statement placed above references; grammar/spelling checks are exempt from disclosure; AI may NOT be listed as an author; AI must not be used to create/alter images (exception: if AI is part of the research design/methods itself, which must then be described in the methods section). No Contemporary-Educational-Psychology-specific AI clause was found beyond this Elsevier-wide policy referenced from the journal's guide-for-authors page (that page itself returned HTTP 403 on fetch, so this is inferred as applying via Elsevier's standard journal template, not confirmed word-for-word on the CEP page).

**WO2 experiential finding:** SciRev's single logged review (rejected outcome) rated overall manuscript-handling 2.5/5, with reviewer comment: process quality was high but very slow, 'holdup was primarily due to the handling editor.' N=1-2 data points only — not a reliable acceptance-rate proxy. Only source is the single SciRev comment above; no corroborating cross-language forum discussion found (see blanks/cross_language_checked).

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without educational-psychology framing
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy
- Pure educational research without psychology theory

### Soft Tax

Low for educational-psychology tradition authors. 24-month AAM embargo on subscription path.

### Best Suited For

- Motivation theory empirical research (achievement goals, SDT)
- Self-regulated learning studies
- Cognitive load and instructional design
- Achievement emotions research
- Technology-enhanced learning empirical work
- Multilevel classroom designs
- Educational psychology meta-analyses

### Not Recommended For

- Pure educational research without psychology theory (consider AERA journals)
- Pure qualitative work
- Pure clinical / counseling psychology

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Educational Psychology](./journal-of-educational-psychology.md) | APA flagship for educational psychology |
| 2 | [Educational Psychology Review](./educational-psychology-review.md) | If reframed as integrative review; Springer |
| 3 | [British Journal of Educational Psychology](./british-journal-of-educational-psychology.md) | BPS-affiliated; UK educational psychology |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from J Edu Psych as "good but not flagship-level," Contemporary Educational Psychology is the Elsevier peer.
